note: ONE row per shot. A player map = filter on `code`; a club map FOR = filter on `team`; a club map AGAINST = filter on `opp`. x = distance from the goal being attacked, as a share of the FULL pitch (105 m) — a DIFFERENT scale from ESPN (half pitch). y = width 0-100, centre 50. The calibration in `calib` is MEASURED from this data: penalties sit at x 11.5 and y 50.00 exactly. `team`/`opp` are null for clubs not in the 2026/27 Premier League (relegated clubs) and `code` is null for an unmatched shooter — NEVER 0. 2025/26 only; no earlier season has shot maps.
